title: Tableau vertex lies within its time block
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ inputs, let $t,n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $j\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $j\le B$, where $B$ is the number of bits in a machine snapshot. The vertex assigned to index $j$ in time block $t$ is strictly less than the base index of time block $t+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ inputs
